summary: Alien Music Club is a named Western North Carolina band/musical consortium (guitarist Jonathan Pearlman, bassist Ben Bjorlie, pianist Taylor Pierson, drummer Jay Hoots) playing jazz, funk, blues, soul and original material, per web search results describing them. They host a monthly jazz jam (first Thursday) at Turgua Brewing in Fairview where other local musicians sit in; the event listings themselves give no venue, description, or membership language beyond AI-generated summaries mentioning 'rotating improvisers' and 'sit-ins from local players'.

evidence.note: 5 monthly listings (2026-06-07 to 2026-09-07) with no organizer, location, or description fields populated; only AI-generated summaries describing a late-night jazz jam with rotating sit-ins.

Official site describes Alien Music Club as 'an eclectic blend of alternative diverse musical genres encompassing all forms of Rock, Jazz and Blues,' but the fetched excerpt gave no member list or jam details.

A web search summary (via Asheville.com/Mountain Xpress listings) describes Alien Music Club as 'a musical consortium of some of the best musicians in Western North Carolina' naming four specific members (Jonathan Pearlman, Ben Bjorlie, Taylor Pierson, Jay Hoots), and states the jam meets every first Thursday at Turgua Brewing in Fairview.

Search turned up a separate 'Alien Music Club Trio' listing, suggesting the name is used both for the core band and for jam-night lineups drawn from it, reinforcing that it is a real named musical act rather than a generic event title.
